objective.title: Derive the normalized-flow quotient-eight estimate
objective.statement: Use the actual mixed tensor and Hessian square bounds to prove the exact pointwise quotient heat-operator bound while retaining the variable normalization term. Preserve the existing arithmetic lemma byte-for-byte.
